item.title: PMO to Shift to ‘Seva Teerth’ on February 13; Last Cabinet Meeting at South Block Marks End of an Era
item.description: Historic Move: Prime Minister’s office relocates, last cabinet meet at south block tomorrow. Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) will officially relocate to its new premises, ‘Seva Teerth,’ on February 13, marking the end of its decades-long functioning from the historic South Block at Raisina Hill. The Union Cabinet will hold its final meeting at South Block tomorrow, closing a significant chapter in India’s administrative history.
